verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents collecting metrics from 'infrastructure' and logs from cloud services, but the pack has no evidence of a vendor-maintained agent or integrations for hosts, containers, or Kubernetes. A community user also reported the docs lacked guidance for host-level CPU, memory and disk metrics. missing for 10: a documented vendor-maintained agent/collector, host and container instrumentation, Kubernetes integration (only deploying SigNoz on Kubernetes is evidenced), a catalog of cloud-service integrations, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Collect metrics from applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups.
Collect logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OpenTelemetry SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services.
